title: The grass that gets trampled
text: A Raipur store manager who went to Russia for a job says he was jailed and pressured to join the Russian army in the war against Ukraine; his family, spending on lawyers, only wants him home.
use: For 'When two elephants fight, it is the grass that gets trampled' (2026).

title: Power checked at the ballot box
text: In the 2026 US midterms, voters handed both houses of Congress to the opposition after a President cast the election as a referendum on himself; the editorial called it democracy's ability to correct itself.
use: For 'Nearly all men can stand adversity, but to test the character, give him power' (2024) and 'A good leader is one who follows the followers' (2026).

title: Pirates contained without escalation
text: Freeing 20 Iranian fishermen from pirates, the Indian Navy first tracked the vessel and contained it with calibrated non-kinetic measures, then intervened swiftly; all the crew came home.
use: For 'The supreme art of war is to subdue the enemy without fighting' (2025) and 'With greater power comes greater responsibility' (2014).

title: Minerals as the new leverage
text: China's dominance over critical mineral processing, used as leverage in trade tensions, shows that power between nations now flows through batteries and supply chains, not only armies.
use: For 'Technology as the silent factor in international relations' (2020).

title: When the architect walks away
text: The US, founder and guarantor of the multilateral order, now rejects it, while a coalition of large and small states from the Global North and South steps in to defend it: the P4M.
use: For 'Has the Non-Alignment Movement (NAM) lost its relevance in a multipolar world' (2017) and 'When two elephants fight, it is the grass that gets trampled' (2026).

title: The players chose their coach
text: After two poor years, Hockey India asked the women's team what it wanted. The players asked for coach Sjoerd Marijne to return. He found a team without cohesion, rebuilt it on a vision 'not of just one', let players hold meetings without the coaches, and kept their Indian flair for dribbling while teaching when to use it. The team beat China for Asian Games gold. Goalkeeper Savita Punia, who had nearly quit two years earlier, said the coaches gave them freedom, and gold was their return gift.
use: For 'A good leader is one who follows the followers' (2026), 'Character of an institution is reflected in its leader' (2015) and 'Courage to accept and dedication to improve are two keys to success' (2019).
